pattern.short_summary: Every unit of displayed content — a word, line, span, or segment — carries a value on some attribute, and that value is rendered by altering the appearance of the unit in place: colour, opacity, weight.
pattern.definition: Every unit of displayed content — a word, line, span, or segment — carries a value on some attribute, and that value is rendered by altering the appearance of the unit in place: colour, opacity, weight. The attribute is read off the content itself rather than from a separate annotation layer or panel.
pattern.structural_signature: A one-to-one map from content units to attribute values, rendered as a visual variable of each unit; the content's text, order, and layout are unchanged, so stripping the encoding restores the original artifact exactly. The display allocates no separate region to the attribute, and the number of encoded marks equals the number of content units.

dimension.category_description: How evidence, internals, correspondence, quality, interpretations, and planned actions are represented for human judgment.
dimension.classification_boundary: The representation must support understanding or verification, rather than merely render output into a usable medium.
